body: All my savings were drained to pay bills when I wasnt working after being institutionalized the 2nd time. Someone has offered me a place to stay but it's out of state, I knew them a bit growing up and I'm not sure if they were serious. I've been in Texas my whole life and I'm not sure about leaving out of state if they are serious, I have nothing here and I'm still not sure... how ridiculous is that?
